name: Cordelia Vane
background: Twenty years on the Ridgeway stage. Married Julian Crane in 1974, divorced him in 1980, and has shared a stage with him every season since.
motive: Crane was leaving for a Hollywood contract after this run and had told the papers the show was 'a vehicle for one'.
opportunity: Had the run of backstage during the interval, and a key to the dressing-room corridor.
personality: Grand, cutting, theatrical even when she's being honest.

relationships.note: Thinks the understudy is 'a very promising boy'.

name: Felix Marsh
background: Three seasons as Crane's understudy. Has gone on for him twice, to better notices than Crane ever got.
motive: With Crane gone, the lead — and the tour — are his.
opportunity: Offstage for the whole second act, with nothing to do but wait.
personality: Eager, jumpy, talks too fast when he's worried.
accessLevel: Company pass (backstage, Green Room, stage door)

name: Harriet Pell
background: Has called every show at the Orpheum for fifteen years from the prompt corner. Found the body.
motive: Crane had her assistant sacked last month after a missed cue, and told her she would be next.
opportunity: Knows every door backstage and holds a master key.
personality: Brisk, exact, and allergic to fuss.

relationships.note: Runs the crew Mae works with.

name: Leonard Voight
background: Found Crane in a touring rep company in 1966 and has managed him ever since. Sat in Box B for every opening night.
motive: None that anyone has heard of. He says Crane was 'like a son'.
opportunity: Was in the audience, in Box B, all night. Or so he says.
personality: Warm, unhurried, generous with cigars and condolences.
accessLevel: Guest of the management (front of house)

relationships.note: Calls Cordelia 'darling' and means none of it.

name: Mae Donnelly
background: Dresses the principals. Has worked Crane's quick changes for two seasons and knows his habits better than anyone.
motive: Crane had accused her of stealing from his coat and threatened to have her dismissed.
opportunity: Free during the second act, once Crane's last change was done.
personality: Quiet, frightened, desperate not to lose her job.
